test_title: RRB ALP CBT-I 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 25 Nov, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: In the Union Budget 2024, which initiative did the Finance Minister announce to enhance productivity in agriculture?

options.text: A new subsidy program for farmers
A comprehensive review of the agriculture research setup

solution:
The correct answer is __**A new subsidy program for farmers**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The new subsidy program is aimed at providing financial assistance to farmers to help reduce the cost of production and increase profitability.
 
• This initiative is expected to enhance productivity by enabling farmers to invest in better quality seeds, fertilizers, and other agricultural inputs.
 
• The subsidy program will also focus on promoting sustainable agricultural practices to ensure long-term benefits for the sector.
 
• By reducing the financial burden on farmers, the program aims to encourage more investment in agriculture, leading to overall growth in the agricultural sector.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Genetically Modified (GM) Crops**

 
 
• GM crops are plants used in agriculture, the DNA of which has been modified using genetic engineering techniques.
 
• The primary aim of developing GM crops is to introduce new traits such as resistance to pests, diseases, environmental conditions, and reduction of spoilage, or to enhance the nutritional value of the crop.
 
• While GM crops have the potential to increase agricultural productivity, there are concerns related to environmental impacts and food safety.
 
 
 
• **Irrigation Facilities**
 
 
• Irrigation is the artificial application of water to the land or soil to assist in growing agricultural crops.
 
• Expansion of irrigation facilities includes the construction of dams, canals, and water reservoirs to ensure a steady supply of water to agricultural fields.
 
• Efficient irrigation systems can significantly increase crop yields and reduce dependence on unpredictable rainfall.
 
 
 
• **Agricultural Research**
 
 
• Agricultural research involves studying various aspects of agriculture to develop new methods, technologies, and practices that can increase productivity and sustainability.
 
• Comprehensive reviews of the agricultural research setup aim to identify gaps, improve research quality, and ensure that research findings are effectively translated into practice.
 
• Investing in agricultural research can lead to innovations that address challenges such as climate change, pest resistance, and soil degradation.
